'''Arts and culture'''
*Two-year-old Aryatara Shakya is installed in [[Kathmandu]] as [[Nepal]]'s new [[Kumari (goddess)|Kumari]], succeeding Trishna Shakya who held the role since 2017. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Cebu earthquake]]
**A {{M|w|6.9}} [[earthquake]] hits the central [[Philippines]] with structural damage and [[power interruption]]s reported, particularly in [[Cebu]] where at least 69 people are reported dead. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/30/central-philippines-hit-by-powerful-earthquake (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/death-toll-from-earthquake-in-cebu-in-the-philippines-rises-to-69-official-says (Reuters via ''The Straits Times'')]
*At least 26 people are killed in a boat accident on the [[Niger River]] in [[Ibaji]], [[Kogi State]], [[Nigeria]]. The cause of the accident is unknown. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-boat-crash-niger-river-a1a33a57b83618adc3b054ddbd9cf76b (AP)]
*Nine people are killed when an under-construction [[coal preparation plant]] collapses in [[Chennai]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/9-killed-in-arch-collapse-at-tamil-nadu-power-plant-pm-announces-compensation-9373869 (NDTV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025 Danish drone incidents]], [[Denmark–Ukraine relations]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] deploys a [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|military]] mission to [[Denmark]] to share its expertise in countering [[Russia]]n [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]], as European countries plan a joint "[[Drone warfare|drone wall]]" project to [[Violations of non-combatant airspaces during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|strengthen airspace defense]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-drones-europe-f15530ce5c47dbba26c334147e684471 (AP)]
*[[France–South Africa relations]]
**[[List of diplomatic missions of South Africa|South African ambassador]] to [[France]] and former [[Minister of Sport, Arts and Culture|sport, arts and culture minister]] [[Nathi Mthethwa]] is found dead outside his hotel in the [[17th arrondissement of Paris|17th arrondissement]] of  [[Paris]]. The ambassador had previously been reported missing by his wife. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/south-africas-ambassador-france-found-dead-paris-le-parisien-2025-09-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Haitian conflict (2020–present)|Haitian conflict]]
**The [[United Nations Security Council]] approves a [[United Nations resolution|resolution]] to transform the [[Multinational Security Support Mission in Haiti|Multinational Security Support Mission]] (MSS) in [[Haiti]] into a larger Gang Suppression Force (GSF) of up to 5,500 police and military personnel to combat [[gang violence]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/30/un-security-council-approves-new-military-force-to-fight-haiti-gangs (''The Guardian'')] [https://news.un.org/en/story/2025/09/1166006 (''UN News'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Moroccan Gen Z protests]]
**Large-scale youth-led demonstrations in [[Morocco]] continue for a third day, despite police arrests and tight security. [https://www.reuters.com/world/morocco-squashes-youth-led-protesters-over-health-education-2025-09-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Capital punishment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**A [[military court]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] sentences former [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|president]] [[Joseph Kabila]] to death ''[[Trial in absentia|in absentia]]'' for [[treason]]. [https://apnews.com/article/joseph-kabila-treason-convicted-death-sentence-m23-rwanda-b2a21a4203fd78e68cf4fc506d56544b (AP)]
*[[Chinese intelligence activity abroad]], [[China–Germany relations]]
**The [[Higher Regional Court of Dresden]] convicts a [[Chinese people in Germany|Chinese–German]] man of [[espionage]] for [[China]] while working for [[Alternative for Germany|AfD]] politician [[Maximilian Krah]], giving him a sentence of over five years. A [[defendant|co-defendant]] accused of supplying cargo and passenger information from her job at [[Leipzig/Halle Airport|Leipzig Airport]] is given a [[suspended sentence]] of one and a half years. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-china-espionage-european-parliament-9882ee9aab8bdaa525b6d8eaa5f8db4f (AP)]
*[[Nord Stream pipelines sabotage]]
**[[Poland|Polish]] authorities arrest a [[Ukrainians in Poland|Ukrainian]] [[Scuba diving|diver]] in [[Pruszków]], [[Masovian Voivodeship]], on a [[Germany|German]] warrant, suspecting his involvement in the 2022 [[Nord Stream]] [[pipeline]] explosions in the [[Baltic Sea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nord-stream-attack-poland-arrest-9764c17af74e594e40956f298c4d0db2 (AP)]
*[[Lèse-majesté in Thailand|''Lèse-majesté'' in Thailand]]
**A [[Thailand|Thai]] [[Judiciary of Thailand|appeals court]] upholds a two-year prison sentence against [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] [[House of Representatives (Thailand)|representative]] [[Chonthicha Jaengraew]] for [[Lèse-majesté|defaming]] the [[Monarchy of Thailand|monarchy]] in a 2021 speech, while granting her [[bail]] pending a [[Supreme Court of Thailand|Supreme Court]] appeal. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-monarchy-appeals-court-chonthicha-royal-defamation-2f53fdd53621ccb66b29c2e9a0e24d23 (AP)]
*[[Mexico]]'s [[National Autonomous University of Mexico|National Autonomous University]] cancels or shifts [[Distance education|classes online]] in over half its [[Academic department|departments]] after the [[Crime in Mexico|killing]] of a student and threats against female professors, prompting authorities to strengthen security and provide support measures. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/mexico-mexico-city-claudia-sheinbaum-b2836965.html (''The Independent'')]
